description.en: Reads the animation frames of a camera loaded with CMND_LOAD_CAMERA: element 0 of the array receives the current frame and element 1 the length of the animation (only as many elements as the array has, at most 2).
Receives [currentFrame, length]; create it with 2 elements.

true once read, false if the camera is not found.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Following the camera animation (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_skl.nut; the Shift-JIS camera name is replaced by a variable here)
